title: Demigorgan
summary: Demigorgan is the Legendary Titan of Betrayal and is the personal Titan of the Betrayer. While its true appearance is that of a huge goat-dog hybrdi with orange armor and disproportionately large arms, Demigorgan is able to alter its form at will to anything it has touched, at its Seeker's demand.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
As part of a grand plan designed by the Betrayer, Demigorgan was disguised as Eathon Lambert's Holotome and was planted by Rassimov in The Professor's castle for Lok Lambert to find. Lok immediately recognised the Holotome as Eathon's from when he was a child and used it to a make plan of attack against the Professor. [The Mission]

When the Huntik team discovered the Nexus in Peru and managed to contact Eathon Lambert in the Spirit World, Demigorgan, as Eathon's Holotome, spied on them, learning Eathon's face and voice so as to impersonate him in the future. [Doorway to Huntik] Demigorgan then began to display messages from Eathon to Lok and the team, giving them clues and leading them to the Legendary Titans Umbra and Phoenix, as the Betrayer knew that the Huntik team would not make it to the Spiral Mark without them. Faking the last prophecies of Nostradamus, the Betrayer was able to trick Lok into driving the Willblade into the Spiral mark, breaking the seal that Lord Casterwill had put in place and signalling the return of the Nullifiers. [The Spiral Mark]

In the battle between the Blood Spiral and the Casterwill-Foundation alliance, Demigorgan was invoked by the Betrayer and was revealed to have been feeding information to the Huntik Foundation. When Zhalia tried to save Lok and Sophie from Demigorgan, it easily defeated her King Basilisk. [Lok and the Betrayer] Demigorgan fought against Den and Harrison Fears and their respective Titans, Dullahan and Jericho, easily defeating Dullahan.

When Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill joined the fight, Demigorgan created copies of the Huntik team to send their Titans back to their Amulets and subsequently take on the forms of these Titans. These clones were defeated by Powerbonded Pendragon, but a subsequent copy of the original Champion of Casterwill was able to subdue. However, Demigorgan was defeated by an empowered Lok, who destroyed its Amulet for good by channeling Quetzalcoatl's energy through the Willblade. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Demigorgan is a creature that is made of crackling energy that is able to transform as required into what suits the situation, including transforming into a fully functional [[Holotome]] {{Source|Lok and the Betrayer}}, or briefly turning into dust and reappearing elsewhere to escape attacks. Another ability allows Demigorgan to subvert the [[Seeker]]-[[Titan]] bond by creating copies of a Seeker or Titan. These copies are then able to hypnotize Seekers and Titans alike through manipulation of the Bond. In direct combat, Demigorgan's primary method of attack is firing powerful energy blasts from its mouth, which can defeat Titans as powerful as [[King Basilisk]]; and with its physical strength, it can easily crush enemies with its fists. As a Legendary Titan, Demigorgan is able to withstand a lot of damage before being sent back to his Amulet, and can move fairly quickly despite its gargantuan size. {{source|Dante's Return}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Demigorgan's name is derived from the [[wikipedia:Demogorgon|Demogorgon]], a demonic and primordial entity occurring in Christian literature from the Middle Ages. Its visual design and abilities heavily echo the [[:wikipedia:Púca|Púca]], a notorious, shape-shifting trickster spirit from Celtic and Irish folklore that frequently manifests as a dark-furred, formidable goat as one of its forms. Its appearance may also have been inspired by the archetypal goat-demon, [[wikipedia:Baphomet|Baphomet]].
* Demigorgan's disguising himself as Eathon's Holotome evokes the story of Puzzle the donkey from C.S. Lewis' ''[[wikipedia:The Last Battle|The Chronicles of Narnia: The Last Battle]]'', wherein Puzzle disguised himself as [[wikipedia:Aslan|Aslan]].
